content: According to BIBREF6, users with high incoming stress tend to request less information from others, as a percentage of their time, and share much more information, in absolute terms. In addition, high information sharing has been shown to be a good predictor of stress reduction at the end of the chat BIBREF6. Regarding information sharing, we rely on Dialogue Acts BIBREF19 to model the speaker's intention in producing an utterance. In particular, we are interested in Dialogue Act label that is defined to represent descriptive, narrative, or personal information – the statement.
